# ParticleCurve

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · class

```csharp
public sealed class ParticleCurve
```

A value that changes over a particle's life (or an emitter's duration), from time 0 to 1, as keys joined by easing curves. Immutable, so one curve can be shared by many effects.

## Remarks

A curve is data: its keys and the shared [`Easing`](Easing.md)s between them.


Types: [`ParticleCurveKey`](ParticleCurveKey.md)

A curve through `keys`, which must be in time order. Before the first key the curve has the first key's value, and after the last, the last key's.
